{{Lunisolar April}} 
'''April 15''' is the 15th day of month {{ill|April (Lunisolar)|ja|4月 (旧暦)|lt=April (Uzuki)}}  the 4th month of the traditional {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦}} . It's {{ill|Rokuyō|ja|六曜}}  day is {{ill|Shakkō|ja|赤口|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shakkō|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11635368}} .
